summarySemantics: Each route is inventoried individually. Controls/state summaries are grouped at family level; they are not per-route capability assertions. For example Configuration has ownership links, not Analytics source/rerun controls; Devices has fleet controls, not Booth prize/publish controls.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native summary date/park selection, source/preference/formula/queue/drift, read-only preview and audited source/rerun; owned settings index links
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Independent read failures/omissions, fixed safe app doors, actual source metadata; absent metadata never guessed
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Q27Stage1 is whole-branch source. Dated splice/unfreeze waits on675/legacy dump. Config is not a generic cross-app writer.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native registry/maintenance; supported flags, exact preview/expiry/reason/confirmation/dual approval; release/agent pagination
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Read authority and request keys, independent history/agent errors, truthful empty-current-page; UI-S3 is the drawer-lifetime candidate
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Unsupported payment/gate/booth flags are catalogue-only, no action. Empty deployment history is known672, not invented.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native kind-aware lookup, action/sale trace, time-limited read-only view-as/history and dual-control paths
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Central actor fence, explicit unknown trace, preserved refusal and session reconciliation; source action callbacks inspected
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: No view-as or trace action by this lane. Three unavailable readers674 and three-app banner gap648 remain known, not claimed fixed.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Existing native operations panels, stock/member searches and own-park selectors, wallet lookup/reactivation
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Working-authority owner keys, stock readback error distinct from a confirmed save, member-tier configuration failure visible
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Inherited page offers and service rules are preserved; no new write, wallet, member or verification rule is proposed here.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Team/routing scope and archive filters, explicit owner/backup edits; operator caps/pacing/rates
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Owned working context, refusal/uncertainty feedback, original routing order/defaults and canonical readback
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Existing Inbox settings open through acting-user doors; no provider/channel mode action.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Trading-day From/To, readable-park selection, native tables/summary cards, bounded CSV; deep-analysis Radar offer
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Context/filter-owned requests, errors distinct from zeros, export lifetime guards in lifted reports/Booth report
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: No formula replacement; different wallet/promo windows stay labelled. Activity export is a separate source candidate.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Read-only Money oversight navigation and safe trace discoverability
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Page offer and links inventoried; money deep-dive delegated to payment auditor
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Nothing on this page is treated as a money writer.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native drop-off/supervision, print templates and station target, role benefits/overrides/credential/history
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Independent reads, owned actor/park/station generations, saved-versus-print continuation ownership and stable retry keys
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Preview and physical command are different permissions. No QR/credential/hardware action was performed by this audit lane.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native discount/tender/tax/type/campaign/event editors, archive, order, branch mint/export
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Management/branch capability offers, confirmations, rejected drafts, late target guards and keyed uncertain retries
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Payment-domain deep correctness is delegated. UI-M4 is banner wording; manual reasons stay genuinely local. Tender archive-after-warning retains approved SCRUM-495 behavior.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native item/category/library/variant forms and search, workbook preview/import/export
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Exact park/operator offers, translation preservation, inherited defaults, fractional monetary inputs, compound-write retry and preview generation guards
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Mock stock toggles remain explicitly nonpersistent; no stock policy is inferred from them.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native forms, tier/default/proof/order, ticket/add-on prices and edit/remove offers
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Narrow ports, target lifecycle guards, retained refused drafts, canonical readback and write uncertainty recovery
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Operator-wide tier offers fail closed; local/mock behavior remains. Half-hour UI versus integer-hours API is recorded Q5, not a new rule fix.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Native operator/branch forms, rename, mapping/reconcile, pricing-calendar ranges and branch selection
familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Captured targets, stale draft fences, native server refusal details, exact-name archive confirmation
familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: Archive blockers are active boxes/stations only; no invented cash blocker. Reconcile/create are not staging audit actions.

familySummaries.stateHandlingSummary: Canonical platform authority and explicit loading/error/empty states; no values exposed for environment names

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Role/permission text search, reverse permission picker, holder lists, effective-diff confirmations; six access-review cards

familySummaries.approvedBehaviorAndLimitsSummary: OTO App mastering and mirrored/archived records remain approved.

familySummaries.controlsSummary: Server name/phone search; Accounts actions, sessions/tokens, app linking/unlinked-user search
